dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。ご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a counselor. Thank you for coming in today. What would you like to talk about?

dialogue.content: よろしくおねがいします
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 学校に行く意味がわかりません
dialogue.English: I don't see the point of going to school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 毎日ただ辛いだけで行ってても何もないです
dialogue.English: It's just painful every day, and I get nothing out of going.

dialogue.content: これならやめたほうが良いかなと
dialogue.English: I'm starting to think it might be better to just quit.

dialogue.content: 辛いか。。。やめた方がよいかな。。。最初にご年齢と性別おききしてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's painful... and you're wondering if it might be better to quit. Before we continue, may I ask for your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 17歳高校2年　女子です
dialogue.English: I’m 17, a second-year in high school, and female.

dialogue.content: でもやめたら先がもっと見えないとも思っていて
dialogue.English: But I also feel that if I quit, my future will be even more uncertain.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。学校行っててもなにもないの？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Does going to school feel like it gives you nothing?

dialogue.content: はい毎日1人です
dialogue.English: Yes. I’m alone every day.

dialogue.content: 勉強もついて行けていません
dialogue.English: I'm not keeping up with my studies, either.

dialogue.content: 1人？友人は？
dialogue.English: Alone? What about friends?

dialogue.content: いますが、私よりも他の人といることが多いです。
dialogue.English: I have some, but they spend more time with others than with me.

dialogue.content: ああそうなんだ。
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: じゃ、どんな時には、一緒にいるの？
dialogue.English: So, when do you usually spend time together?

dialogue.content: 部活の友人なので
dialogue.English: They're my friends from my club, so...

dialogue.content: 部活の時は話します
dialogue.English: we talk during club activities.

dialogue.content: クラスは違うので
dialogue.English: We’re in different classes.

dialogue.content: 部活してるんだ。クラス違うのね
dialogue.English: So you’re in a club. And in different classes, huh.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 部活って？
dialogue.English: Which club are you in?

dialogue.content: 化学部です
dialogue.English: The chemistry club.

dialogue.content: へぇ～　化学！！
dialogue.English: Wow, chemistry!

dialogue.content: 特にやりたいこともなかったので
dialogue.English: I didn't have anything in particular I wanted to do, so...

dialogue.content: 受験にいいかなとか思ったぐらいです
dialogue.English: I just thought it might be good for college entrance exams or something.

dialogue.content: やりたいことなかったって、それで化学なんてすごい。
dialogue.English: It's impressive that you chose chemistry even though you didn't have anything you particularly wanted to do.

dialogue.content: 受験にいいか！　なるほど
dialogue.English: Good for entrance exams! I see.

dialogue.content: いえ結局化学も得意でないことがわかりました
dialogue.English: No, it turns out I'm not good at chemistry either.

dialogue.content: そうなのね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 中学校までは勉強もできていて
dialogue.English: I was good at my studies up until middle school,

dialogue.content: 中学までは勉強できていて？
dialogue.English: You were good at your studies until middle school?

dialogue.content: 友達もいたのですが
dialogue.English: and I had friends, too.

dialogue.content: 友達もいたんだ！。今はそうじゃないのね
dialogue.English: You had friends! But it's not like that now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつごろから、勉強ができないな　と思い始めたの？
dialogue.English: When did you start to feel like you couldn't keep up with your studies?

dialogue.content: 高校に入ってからです
dialogue.English: Since I started high school.

dialogue.content: テストの成績もどんどん落ちて
dialogue.English: My test scores kept getting worse and worse,

dialogue.content: そうなのね。高校は受験で入ったの？
dialogue.English: I see. Did you get into your high school through an entrance exam?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 頑張っていい高校に入ったとは思っていました
dialogue.English: I thought I had worked hard to get into a good high school.

dialogue.content: いい高校？どうして今の高校選んだのか、お話してくれる？
dialogue.English: A good high school? Could you tell me why you chose your current school?

dialogue.content: 地元では優秀な方で進学校だから
dialogue.English: Because it's known as one of the better, college-preparatory schools in my area.

dialogue.content: そうなのね。じゃ、高校受験の時は、その先の進学も考えていたのね。
dialogue.English: I see. So when you were taking your high school entrance exams, you were already thinking about going on to college afterward.

dialogue.content: どんなイメージだったの？
dialogue.English: What did you imagine it would be like?

dialogue.content: 入れるなら入りたいところだと思いました進学はするだろうとは思っていましたがそこまで深く考えていなかったです
dialogue.English: I just thought it was a place I'd want to go to if I could get in. I assumed I'd go on to higher education, but I hadn't thought about it that deeply.

dialogue.content: でも通いだしたら全然だめでした
dialogue.English: But once I started attending, it just didn’t go well at all.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。詳しく教えてくれて。中学では成績よかったから、ちょっとがんばったら入れるところだったんだね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing the details. Since you did well in middle school, it was a place you could get into with a bit of effort.

dialogue.content: 通いだしたら、全然だめだった？　全然？
dialogue.English: After you started, it didn’t go well at all? Not at all?

dialogue.content: そうですねかなり後ろの方です。今ではやる気もなくて家でも勉強していません。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm pretty near the bottom of the class. Now I have no motivation and don't study at home, either.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。今はやる気が出てこないのね。そういう気持ちは、だれかに話せている？
dialogue.English: I see. So you can't find the motivation right now. Have you been able to talk to anyone about these feelings?

dialogue.content: 赤点をとってしまったこともあります
dialogue.English: I've even gotten a failing grade before.

dialogue.content: いいえ話せません
dialogue.English: No, I can't talk about it.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい。ちょっとずれちゃったね。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry. I got a little off track.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: It's okay.

dialogue.content: 赤点とってしまったときはどんな気持ちだったの？
dialogue.English: How did you feel when you got that failing grade?

dialogue.content: ショックです
dialogue.English: It was a shock.

dialogue.content: もう終わりだなって感じ
dialogue.English: I felt like it was all over.

dialogue.content: ショック！！　終わった！！か。
dialogue.English: A shock! 'It was all over,' huh.

dialogue.content: 再試験はあったの？
dialogue.English: Was there a make-up test?

dialogue.content: はい、その時はなんとかなりました。でも、それよりもがっこうにいること自体が辛くなってきました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I managed to get through it that time. But more than that, just being at school has become painful.

dialogue.content: なんのために行っているのかわからなくなってしまいました
dialogue.English: I've lost sight of why I'm even going.

dialogue.content: 友達もいなくて
dialogue.English: And I don't have any friends there.

dialogue.content: 再試験は挽回できたんだね。がんばった？わからなくなった
dialogue.English: So you were able to recover on the re-take. You worked hard, huh? But now you've lost sight of things.

dialogue.content: 赤点とるような状態で
dialogue.English: I’m at the point where I’m getting failing marks,

dialogue.content: いま、高2だよね。ともだちずっといないの？
dialogue.English: You're in your second year of high school, right? Have you been without friends this whole time?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Pretty much, yes.

dialogue.content: 他には、赤点って、全部の科目が赤点？
dialogue.English: And about the failing marks—were they in all subjects?

dialogue.content: 大学もこれじゃ無理
dialogue.English: At this rate, college is impossible.

dialogue.content: 大学これじゃ無理だって思ってしまっているのね。
dialogue.English: You feel that you won't be able to get into college at this rate.

dialogue.content: そんなことはないですが全般的にだめです
dialogue.English: Not all of them, but I'm doing poorly overall.

dialogue.content: 大学受からないです
dialogue.English: I won't get into college.

dialogue.content: そもそも何を目指すのかもわからないです。
dialogue.English: I don't even know what to aim for in the first place.

dialogue.content: 赤点は全部じゃないけど、全般的にそう感じて、大学も受からないって思うのね。
dialogue.English: So you're not failing every subject, but you feel like you're doing poorly overall and you're thinking you won’t get into college.

dialogue.content: そうか。なにを目指すのか　ね。
dialogue.English: I see. What to aim for, huh.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 子どものころは何になりたいと思っていたの？
dialogue.English: When you were a child, what did you want to be?

dialogue.content: 飛行機のCAとか？
dialogue.English: A flight attendant, maybe?

dialogue.content: 学校のせんせいとか？
dialogue.English: Or a school teacher?

dialogue.content: そうなんだ　CAのどういう点が魅力？
dialogue.English: I see. What did you find appealing about being a flight attendant?

dialogue.content: 学校の先生のどういう点が自分もやりたいとおもったの？
dialogue.English: And what was it about being a school teacher that made you want to do it yourself?

dialogue.content: スマートでかっこいいし、しっかりしてるイメージ
dialogue.English: They have a poised, cool, and competent image.

dialogue.content: CAさんも学校の先生も？
dialogue.English: Both flight attendants and teachers?

dialogue.content: いい先生に当たった時はこんな先生ならいいなとは
dialogue.English: When I had a good teacher, I thought it would be nice to be a teacher like that.

dialogue.content: いい先生か・・・　いい先生に当たったのはいつ？
dialogue.English: A good teacher... When did you have a good teacher?

dialogue.content: CAがスマート
dialogue.English: The flight attendants are the smart/poised ones.

dialogue.content: CAがスマートね。学校の先生のイメージは？
dialogue.English: Flight attendants are smart, I see. What's your image of a school teacher?

dialogue.content: その先生なりに、いいところがありますよね。
dialogue.English: Each teacher has their own good qualities, right?

dialogue.content: そうそう。その先生なりに味があるよね。
dialogue.English: That's right. Each teacher has their own unique charm.

dialogue.content: でも、自分のイメージとは違う気がしています
dialogue.English: But I feel like that's different from how I see myself.

dialogue.content: 自分のイメージと違うって？
dialogue.English: Different from how you see yourself?

dialogue.content: 私は積極的に自分からコミュニケーションがとれないです。
dialogue.English: I can’t proactively initiate communication with people.

dialogue.content: 先生はそれでは良くないと思います。
dialogue.English: I don't think that's a good quality for a teacher to have.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。自分からはコミュニケーションとりにいくの苦手なの？
dialogue.English: I see. So you find it difficult to initiate communication yourself?

dialogue.content: そうですねだから今こんなことになっているんだと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think that's why I'm in this situation now.

dialogue.content: コミュ力が十分じゃないと、学校の先生にはよくないと感じているのね。すごい分析力。
dialogue.English: So you feel that not having enough communication skills isn't good for a teacher. That's very analytical of you.

dialogue.content: 大切なことですよね。自分は苦手でそれなのに友達がいないっていってるんですから
dialogue.English: It's important, isn't it? I'm bad at it, and yet I'm the one saying I don't have friends.

dialogue.content: そんなことで悩んでるのがおかしいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it strange to be troubled by something like this?

dialogue.content: ぜんぜん　おかしくないのよ。
dialogue.English: Not at all. It's not strange in the slightest.

dialogue.content: たとえばだけど、
dialogue.English: For example,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: アサーションっていう言葉聞いたことある？
dialogue.English: Have you ever heard the word "assertion"?

dialogue.content: 聞いたことだけはありますがわからないです。
dialogue.English: I've only heard of it, but I don't know what it means.

dialogue.content: ちょっと、その話をしてもいい？
dialogue.English: May I talk about that for a little bit?

dialogue.content: はいお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: じゃぁね。ドラえもんの話で
dialogue.English: Okay. Let's use Doraemon as an example.

dialogue.content: スネ夫が、イチゴを3個もっているとして。
dialogue.English: Let's say Suneo has three strawberries.

dialogue.content: それを食べたいジャイアンは何て言うと思う？
dialogue.English: What do you think Gian would say if he wanted to eat them?

dialogue.content: ジャイアンなら俺によこせですかね
dialogue.English: If it's Gian, he'd probably say, "Give 'em to me!"

dialogue.content: そうそう。私もそう思う。それで、スネ夫はどうすると思う？
dialogue.English: Exactly. I think so too. And what do you think Suneo would do?

dialogue.content: えーでも、1個ならいいよでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Um... maybe he'd say, "Okay, you can have one"?

dialogue.content: いやいや、ジャイアンは3個ともくれ　と言い張る！
dialogue.English: No, no—Gian would insist, "Give me all three!"

dialogue.content: あなたがスネ夫だったらどんな気持ちになる？
dialogue.English: If you were Suneo, how would you feel?

dialogue.content: えーひどいでも、こわいから仕方がないですか？
dialogue.English: Ugh, that's awful... but he's scary, so I guess I'd have no choice?

dialogue.content: 私がスネ夫でもそう思うかも。それで、3個あげちゃったら悲しくなるよね。
dialogue.English: I might feel the same way if I were Suneo. And if you gave him all three, you'd feel sad, right?

dialogue.content: はいそうですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 高校に入ってから、そういう悲しい場面に遭ったことはある？
dialogue.English: Has anything sad like that happened to you since you started high school?

dialogue.content: いえ多分そういうタイプの人と接することもなかったと思います。
dialogue.English: No, I don't think I've really interacted with people like that.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。今の学校には、ジャイアンみたいな人はいないのかもしれないね。
dialogue.English: I see. Maybe there aren't any people like Gian at your current school.

dialogue.content: じゃ、話し換えて、のび太だったら、スネ夫のイチゴほしい時　何て言うかしら？
dialogue.English: Then, to change the scenario, what do you think Nobita would say if he wanted Suneo's strawberries?

dialogue.content: というかわからないですが、自分がそもそも話しかけてもらえていないのかなと思います
dialogue.English: I'm not sure... I feel like maybe people don't even talk to me in the first place.

dialogue.content: のび太ならえーいいないいなですかね
dialogue.English: If it were Nobita, maybe he'd say, "Wow, those look good..."

dialogue.content: え～　いいないいな　で、それでイチゴ食べられるのかな？
dialogue.English: By saying, "Wow, those look good..." do you think he'd get to eat a strawberry?

dialogue.content: のび太はすぐにドラえもんに頼りに行きますよね。
dialogue.English: Nobita would immediately go ask Doraemon for help, wouldn't he?

dialogue.content: なんかそんなイメージで
dialogue.English: That's the kind of image I have.

dialogue.content: あはは、よくわかっているね！
dialogue.English: Haha, you know the characters well!

dialogue.content: 自分ひとりじゃ、のび太は自己主張もできない。。。
dialogue.English: On his own, Nobita can't even assert himself...

dialogue.content: どうでしょうなんだかそんな気がします。ドラえもんにいちご僕もたべたいと
dialogue.English: I'm not sure, but I kind of feel that way. He'd tell Doraemon, "I want to eat some strawberries too."

dialogue.content: ドラえもん、現実的には飛んでこないからねえ。じゃ、しずかちゃんだったら、スネ夫に何て言うかしら？
dialogue.English: Well, in reality, Doraemon isn't going to come flying to help, is he? So, what do you think Shizuka would say to Suneo?

dialogue.content: はいしずかちゃんなら一つわけてくれない？と言えそうですね
dialogue.English: Right. If it were Shizuka, she could probably say, "Could you share one with me?"

dialogue.content: そうね。私もそう思う。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so too.

dialogue.content: 3個じゃなくて、ひとつ　だよね。
dialogue.English: Not all three, just one, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: ね。今のあなたは、ジャイアン、のび太、しずかちゃんのどのタイプだと思う？
dialogue.English: So, which type do you think you are right now: Gian, Nobita, or Shizuka?

dialogue.content: どれでもないですね
dialogue.English: None of them, really.

dialogue.content: あえて言えばスネ夫かも
dialogue.English: If I had to pick, maybe Suneo.

dialogue.content: そうなの？どういう点がスネ夫？
dialogue.English: Really? In what way are you like Suneo?

dialogue.content: 何かあることで、会話ができる
dialogue.English: I can talk when there’s something specific to talk about.

dialogue.content: いじいじしてそう
dialogue.English: He seems timid and indecisive.

dialogue.content: うんうん。何かあることで会話ができる。いじいじ？
dialogue.English: Uh-huh. You can have a conversation if there's a specific reason. And timid and indecisive?

dialogue.content: スネ夫いじいじしてますよね
dialogue.English: Suneo is timid and indecisive, isn't he?

dialogue.content: 素直な感じしないです
dialogue.English: He doesn’t come across as straightforward.

dialogue.content: 何かあることで会話ができるのは、いじいじじゃないと思うよ。
dialogue.English: I don't think being able to have a conversation when there's a specific topic is the same as being timid and indecisive.

dialogue.content: いじいじって？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by that 'timid and indecisive' quality?

dialogue.content: 思っていることを素直に言わずに、なんか遠回しというか・・・
dialogue.English: Not saying what you're thinking directly... being kind of roundabout...

dialogue.content: 裏があるような
dialogue.English: Like he has an ulterior motive.

dialogue.content: そう感じるのね。
dialogue.English: That’s how he comes across to you.

dialogue.content: そんなイメージです
dialogue.English: That's the image I have.

dialogue.content: 一番嫌いですが、私に近いのは彼だと思います。
dialogue.English: He's the one I dislike the most, but I think I'm the most similar to him.

dialogue.content: スネ夫は一番嫌いだけど、自分が一番近いような気がしているのね。でも、スネ夫も自分の言いたいことは遠回しでも、言えてるよね。
dialogue.English: So you dislike Suneo the most, but you feel you're most similar to him. But even if it's in a roundabout way, Suneo still says what he wants to say, doesn't he?

dialogue.content: それはそこまでの関係を築けた間柄だからかと思います
dialogue.English: I think that's because they've built up that kind of relationship.

dialogue.content: 仲良いですよね
dialogue.English: They're close, aren't they?

dialogue.content: そこまでの関係の間柄だからと思うのですね。でも最初からそうじゃない。
dialogue.English: So you think it's because of the kind of relationship they have. But it wasn't like that from the very beginning.

dialogue.content: 私も仲が良くなれば、いろんなこと話したり、愚痴ったり、そうだできると思っていました。
dialogue.English: I also thought that once I became close with someone, I’d be able to talk about various things, vent, and things like that.

dialogue.content: そう感じているのね。そういう仲間が欲しいと感じているの？
dialogue.English: That's how you feel. Do you feel like you want friends like that?

dialogue.content: そうですねそのような友達がいないことが辛いです。
dialogue.English: Yes. It’s painful not having friends like that.

dialogue.content: 家族とは、どんな感じで話しているの？
dialogue.English: What are your conversations like with your family?

dialogue.content: 家族とはそのような話はしていないです。
dialogue.English: I don't talk about things like that with my family.

dialogue.content: そうなのね。いまアサーションの話をしていたのよね。
dialogue.English: I see. We were just talking about assertion, weren't we?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: アサーションって、自己主張をする　ということなんだけど、
dialogue.English: Assertion means expressing yourself, but...

dialogue.content: 自分も相手も、気持ちがいい　win winみたいな感じの　自己主張のことなの。
dialogue.English: it's a kind of self-expression where both you and the other person feel good, like a win-win situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: いま、自分の思いをうまく友達に話せない気持ちなんだよね？　というか相手がいない感じがする・・・
dialogue.English: Right now, you feel like you can't express your thoughts well to your friends, right? Or rather, you feel like you don't have anyone to talk to...

dialogue.content: はいそう思います
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s how I feel.

dialogue.content: 自分の気持ちを主張できないから、学校も面白くないのかな？
dialogue.English: Maybe school feels unfulfilling because you can't express your feelings?

dialogue.content: 主張したいとは思わないです。
dialogue.English: I don't really feel like I want to assert myself.

dialogue.content: でも、気楽に話せて安心したい気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.English: But maybe I just want to be able to talk casually and feel at ease?

dialogue.content: うんうん。そう思うのね。
dialogue.English: Uh-huh. So that's what you're feeling.

dialogue.content: 勉強もわからないのにそのことを話す友達もいない
dialogue.English: I don't understand my schoolwork, and I don't have any friends to talk about it with.

dialogue.content: 友達から、勉強もわからない人とは　話したくないって言われたの？
dialogue.English: Did a friend tell you they don't want to talk to someone who doesn't understand their schoolwork?

dialogue.content: そんなことはないです。話せるような友達がいない感じです。
dialogue.English: No, nothing like that. It's more like I don't have friends I can talk to in that way.

dialogue.content: 本当にゆるい関係というか
dialogue.English: It's a really superficial relationship, I guess.

dialogue.content: ゆるい関係？
dialogue.English: A superficial relationship?

dialogue.content: 表面上のという感じです。
dialogue.English: It feels superficial.

dialogue.content: 表面上ね。あなたは、深いところでもいろいろ話せる友達が欲しいなって感じているのかしら。
dialogue.English: Superficial, I see. I wonder if you're feeling like you want friends you can talk with on a deeper level.

dialogue.content: そうですね。勉強わからないといっても、今ならそうなんだ難しいよねで終わる程度かなと
dialogue.English: Yes. Even if I were to say I don't understand my studies, right now it would probably just end with them saying, "Oh, I see. It is difficult, isn't it?"

dialogue.content: それはそれでいいのですが
dialogue.English: And that's fine in its own way, but...

dialogue.content: そうなのね。それはそれでいいの？
dialogue.English: I see. Is that really fine with you?

dialogue.content: その子が悪いわけではないので
dialogue.English: It's not the other person's fault.

dialogue.content: わたしがうまくできないからそうなってしまうのだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it ends up that way because I'm not good at handling the conversation.

dialogue.content: ああ、そういうふうに感じているんだ。
dialogue.English: Ah, so that's how you feel.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: さっきの、スネ夫だとしたら、勉強わからないといっても、今ならそうなんだ難しいよねのあとに、何て言うかしら？
dialogue.English: Going back to our earlier example, if you were Suneo, and you told someone you don't understand your studies and they just said, "Oh, that's tough," what would you say next?

dialogue.content: のび太が相談してきてスネ夫がどう答えるかということですか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean what Suneo would say if Nobita came to him for advice?

dialogue.content: そうね。相手は、のび太じゃなくても、しずかちゃんでもいいよ。
dialogue.English: Yes. The other person doesn't have to be Nobita; it could be Shizuka, for example.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ一緒に勉強する？というでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would he say, "I see. Want to study together?"

dialogue.content: だれかによるのかなと
dialogue.English: I guess it depends on who it is.

dialogue.content: のび太だったらお前じゃ無理かもねしずかちゃんだったら僕が教えてあげるよですよね
dialogue.English: If it were Nobita, he'd say, "You probably can't do it." But if it were Shizuka, he'd say, "I'll teach you."

dialogue.content: スネ夫はそのような子ではないかと
dialogue.English: I feel like that’s the kind of person Suneo is.

dialogue.content: 人によって態度が変わる感じ？
dialogue.English: Someone who changes their attitude depending on the person?

dialogue.content: 一あはは、それにしても、あなたはとても、分析力があると感じますよ。あなたの中のスネ夫は、相手によって変わる感じ？
dialogue.English: Haha, even so, I feel you are very analytical. Does the Suneo inside you change depending on who you're with?

dialogue.content: わたしはそういう人間ではないと思いました。
dialogue.English: I don't think I’m that kind of person.

dialogue.content: 人によって態度を変えられるほど器用ではないです。
dialogue.English: I'm not skillful enough to change my attitude depending on the person.

dialogue.content: じゃ、スネ夫じゃなくて、しずかちゃんになりたいと思わない？
dialogue.English: Then, instead of Suneo, don't you want to be like Shizuka?

dialogue.content: もちろんなりたいですよね
dialogue.English: Of course I would.

dialogue.content: なりたくて、なれるのなら苦労しないと思うのですが。
dialogue.English: If I could become like her just by wanting to, I wouldn't be struggling.

dialogue.content: じゃ、友達からそうなんだ難しいよねって言われたとき、しずかちゃんなら何ていうと思う？
dialogue.English: Okay, so, if you told a friend your studies were difficult and they just said, "Oh, I see, that's tough," what do you think Shizuka would say next in order to get help?

dialogue.content: 手伝おうか？でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Maybe, "Should I help you?"

dialogue.content: ちがいますね
dialogue.English: No, that's not it.

dialogue.content: あ、そっちじゃなくて、
dialogue.English: Oh, not that way,

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: わかるなら教えてくれない？
dialogue.English: 'If you understand it, could you teach me?'

dialogue.content: ですかね
dialogue.English: Something like that.

dialogue.content: すばらしい！
dialogue.English: Wonderful!

dialogue.content: その一言を思いついたのね。
dialogue.English: You were able to come up with that phrase.

dialogue.content: しずかちゃんは、もともとコミュ力高い子だから
dialogue.English: Shizuka already has strong communication skills,

dialogue.content: そういうお願いもできる関係を作れていると思います。
dialogue.English: so I think she's able to build relationships where she can make requests like that.

dialogue.content: あなたは、中学の頃はどうだったの？
dialogue.English: What were you like back in middle school?

dialogue.content: ここまで悩んでいなかったと思います。
dialogue.English: I don’t think I was struggling this much.

dialogue.content: 友達もいました。
dialogue.English: I had friends.

dialogue.content: どちらかというと頼られていた方だったかと
dialogue.English: If anything, I think I was the one people relied on.

dialogue.content: 今はだれからも頼られる存在ではないですよね。
dialogue.English: Now, no one relies on me.

dialogue.content: 友達もいたんだよね。そうだと思っていました。頼られていたんだね。だからそのころと比べて　今　を　悲しく思うのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: You had friends. I thought so. People relied on you. That's probably why you feel sad about your current situation compared to back then.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 自分が情け無いと思っています。
dialogue.English: I feel pathetic.

dialogue.content: 本当に誰からもでしょうか？　今はだれからもでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it really no one? Right now, is it no one at all?

dialogue.content: 今は、そう感じています。こんなことで悩んでいることが辛いです。
dialogue.English: That’s how it feels right now. It’s painful to be struggling with something like this.

dialogue.content: ねえ、人から頼られないと、人を頼ってはいけないの？
dialogue.English: Hey, if people don't rely on you, does that mean you can't rely on others?

dialogue.content: WIN WINと先ほどあったと思うのですが、
dialogue.English: You mentioned "win-win" earlier, and...

dialogue.content: お互いに助け合える関係になりたいなと思っています。
dialogue.English: I want to have relationships where we can help each other.

dialogue.content: 今のわたしには助ける力が見当たらない。
dialogue.English: Right now, I don't see any ability in myself to help others.

dialogue.content: それは、今の　成績だけを感じているから、そう思うんじゃないかしら。
dialogue.English: I wonder if you feel that way because you’re focusing only on your current grades.

dialogue.content: そうですねでも、ほかも見つけられていない。多分自分もそれを認めたくなくてこうなっているのかなと思います
dialogue.English: That’s true, but I also haven’t found anything else. Maybe I don’t want to admit that to myself, and that’s why things are the way they are.

dialogue.content: Lineだったけどね、今までの会話の中で、あなたはとても分析力と、冷静に物事を考えられる力があると感じます。中学の頃から考えても、そういうことはかんじませんか？
dialogue.English: This has all been over text, but throughout our conversation, I feel that you have strong analytical skills and the ability to think calmly about things. Thinking back to your middle school days, don't you feel that way too?

dialogue.content: そういっていただけると嬉しいです。でもこの高校では自分が誇れるものが作れないことがわかってしまっているのだと思います。
dialogue.English: I'm happy to hear you say that. But I think I've realized that at this high school, I can't create anything to be proud of.

dialogue.content: 悩んでいることもなやみすぎなのかと自分を責めてしまいます。
dialogue.English: I also blame myself, wondering if I’m overthinking my problems.

dialogue.content: 自分を責めなくていいのよ。いま、高2の9月だから、あと1年半、高校生活あるよね。
dialogue.English: You don't have to blame yourself. It's September of your second year, so you still have a year and a half of high school left, right?

dialogue.content: はい長いです。
dialogue.English: Yes—it feels long.

dialogue.content: 進路決めないといけないのに・・・
dialogue.English: And I have to decide on my future path...

dialogue.content: 実は、同じように、頑張って受験でいい高校に入ったあと、中学校の時みたいに成績上位を取れなくて悩んでいる高校生はたくさんいるのよ。
dialogue.English: Actually, there are many high school students who, like you, worked hard on their entrance exams to get into a good high school, and then struggle because they can't get top grades like they did in middle school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか？
dialogue.English: Really?

dialogue.content: そうですよねわたしみたいな成績の人はたくさんいますよね
dialogue.English: That's right... There must be a lot of students with grades like mine.

dialogue.content: はい。そうだよね。じゃ、たとえばだけど、東大に行った人が、就職後に、全員、社長になっていると思う？
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right. For example, do you think everyone who goes to the University of Tokyo becomes a company president after they get a job?

dialogue.content: それはないですよね
dialogue.English: No, of course not.

dialogue.content: そうだよね。肝心なのは、いい大学に行くことじゃなくて、その先に、どういう仕事をするか　だと思うんだけど。
dialogue.English: Exactly. I think what's important isn't just going to a good university, but what kind of work you do after that.

dialogue.content: はいわたしもそう思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so too.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。じゃ、たとえば　CAさんはたくさんいるけど、どういうCAさんに機内サービスしてほしいと思う？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So, for example, there are many flight attendants, but what kind of flight attendant would you want to be served by on a plane?

dialogue.content: テキパキしていて笑顔を絶やさず気がきいてくれる人何かあったら、頼れそうな人
dialogue.English: Someone who is efficient, always smiling, and attentive. Someone you could rely on if something happened.

dialogue.content: そうそう、気が利いてて、頼れそうな人、いちいち注文しなくても、さっと水をもってきてくれるような？
dialogue.English: Exactly, someone who is attentive and reliable, who would bring you water without you even having to ask?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: 学校の先生だったら？
dialogue.English: What about for a school teacher?

dialogue.content: やはり、生徒一人一人を同じように大切に扱ってくれる人
dialogue.English: Someone who treats each and every student with the same care and respect.

dialogue.content: う～ん　そうだよね。あなたは、とても、相手のことを大事に扱うタイプの人だと思います。相手のためにベストが何か？を考えて、ぜひ自分もそういうｋとをしてあげたい　と思っているタイプなんじゃないかな。
dialogue.English: Mmm, that's right. I think you're the type of person who treats others with great care. You think about what's best for the other person and really want to do that for them, don't you?

dialogue.content: そういうことをしてあげたいでした。
dialogue.English: I mean, you want to do those things for others.

dialogue.content: そうですねそうだと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think that’s true.

dialogue.content: だからこそ、自分がいま、友達にしてあげられることがないから、頼っちゃいけないと感じているのね。
dialogue.English: And that's exactly why you feel you can't rely on your friends—because you feel you have nothing to offer them right now.

dialogue.content: そうだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: じゃ、生徒ひとりひとりを大切に扱ってくれる先生になるため、や、理想のCA、あるいは、人のために尽くせる仕事に就くためには、これからどういう進路を進めばいいか？
dialogue.English: Then, in order to become a teacher who treats every student with care, or your ideal flight attendant, or to get a job where you can serve others, what kind of path should you take from now on?

dialogue.content: 考えてみることはできるでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that something you could think about?

dialogue.content: まずは進路ということですね。
dialogue.English: So, my future path first, right.

dialogue.content: 正直CAや先生はいまなりたいとはおもっていないです
dialogue.English: Honestly, I don't want to be a flight attendant or a teacher right now.

dialogue.content: でも他の職種を探してみようと思います。
dialogue.English: But I think I'll try looking into other types of jobs.

dialogue.content: 進路が見つかれば、勉強はやれるようになるのかわかりませんが。
dialogue.English: I’m not sure if finding a future path will make me able to study, though.

dialogue.content: はい、それでいいと思います。でも、できれば、人のために　尽くしているという気持ちになれるお仕事がいいような気がします。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think that's a good plan. If possible, I have a feeling that a job where you feel that you’re serving others would be a good fit for you.

dialogue.content: なにもない自分は確かに良くないと思いました。
dialogue.English: I agree that it's not good to be a person with nothing to offer.

dialogue.content: まず、自分のことをもっと考えてみようと思います。
dialogue.English: First, I'm going to try to think more about myself.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: だって、あなたは高校受験のときに、目標をさだめて勉強ができた人ですよ。いまは、進路を定めておけば勉強への考え方が変わるような気がします。
dialogue.English: After all, you're someone who was able to set a goal and study for your high school entrance exams. I feel that if you decide on a future path now, your attitude toward studying might change.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれないです
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。時間長くなりました。　進路って、大学の進学先だけではなくて、実は　その先の、将来の仕事に照準を定めてほしいな　と思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. I'm sorry we've gone over our time. When you think about your future path, I hope you'll focus not just on which university to go to, but on the future job you want beyond that.

dialogue.content: はいわかりました。やってみます
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. I’ll give it a try.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。（なんだかうまくまとめられずに、時間を経ました。ではこれでロープレを終了させていただきます。お友達とのアサーションも頑張ってください。では失礼します）
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. (I feel I didn’t wrap this up as neatly as I’d hoped, and we’ve gone over time. We'll end the role-play here. I wish you the best with practicing assertion with your friends as well. Take care.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much as well.)
